facts.fact: Pops 在 Carson 四岁时看她骑自己的母马，说她是天生的赛手
facts.anchor: when I was four years old

facts.fact: Carson 六岁时骑第一匹马 Whiskey 开始参赛
facts.anchor: By six, I was competing on my first horse, Whiskey.

facts.fact: Carson 十二岁时经常获胜，在东南部打响名气
facts.anchor: By twelve, I was winning regularly and making a name for myself across the Southeast.

facts.fact: Blueberry 是 Pops 在 Carson 赢得第一个青年冠军后送给她的礼物
facts.anchor: gift to me after I won my first youth championship

facts.fact: Carson 把赞助邮件读了三遍才相信，随后又读了第四遍和第五遍
facts.anchor: I read the email three times before I finally believed it.

facts.fact: Carson 答应 Pops 等自己转正后给他买全乔治亚州最好的卡车
facts.anchor: buying you the nicest truck in Georgia

facts.fact: Meme 在 Carson 出发前拥抱了她两次
facts.anchor: Meme hugged me twice before I climbed

facts.fact: 那辆红色 Ford F-150 是 Pops 在 Carson 十六岁时买给她的
facts.anchor: the red Ford F-150 Pops bought for me when I turned sixteen
